verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Pandoc only as a conversion CLI and library. Nothing shows Pandoc itself letting users set up, schedule or run autonomous background automations. Running it via GitHub Actions is a host-platform capability, calling it from user scripts is a user-side workaround, and pandoc-server HTTP mode is an adjacent building block, not an automation feature. None of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
